title: One item of the site index (dist/data/index.json, built by scripts/site-index.mjs, never committed): an experiment, a lab, a field note, an update or a tool, with the page it links to
$comment: Closed sets are written as patterns: scripts/json-schema-lite.mjs has no enum keyword. stage: an experiment's ledger stage (Recorded -> recorded, Measured -> measured, Results published -> results, Pre-registered -> pre-registered); a lab's kind (results, pre-registered) or running for Lab 01; an update's kind (Results, Erratum, Amendment, Pre-registered, Measured, Recorded, Tool, Field note -> results, erratum, amendment, pre-registered, measured, recorded, tool, note); note and tool for those types. outcome is curated in site/data/find-outcomes.json, never inferred from words, and only an experiment or the results update of one carries it.

href.description: Relative to the site root: no scheme, no leading slash, no dot segments.
